tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description:
Has this home's asking price changed? Every change Cubi observed.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_properties, get_listing, get_contact_options, filter_listings, compare_asking_prices, find_similar_elsewhere, find_similar_homes · Private data: search_properties, get_listing, get_contact_options, filter_listings · Public sink: get_listing, get_contact_options, filter_listings, compare_inventory, data_layer_stats · Destructive: search_properties, filter_listings, corpus_stats.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_properties, get_listing, get_contact_options, filter_listings, compare_asking_prices, find_similar_elsewhere, find_similar_homes · Private data: search_properties, get_listing, get_contact_options, filter_listings · Public sink: get_listing, get_contact_options, filter_listings, compare_inventory, data_layer_stats · Destructive: search_properties, filter_listings, corpus_stats

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "filter_listings" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
